{{Top|leg}}
The '''Free Axxilans''' were [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Loyalist/Legends|loyalists]] who emigrated from [[Axxila/Legends|Axxila]] after the corporate interests that controlled the [[Ciutric Hegemony]] seceded to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]]. Many of them relocated to [[Halmad/Legends|Halmad]], among them, the family of the young [[Firmus Piett/Legends|Firmus Piett]].
